description: This file defines the MidiEventScheduler class, which extends EventScheduler to manage and schedule MIDI events using Android's MidiReceiver. It includes nested classes for handling MIDI events and a specialized receiver that processes incoming MIDI messages, scheduling them for execution.

classes.name: MidiEventScheduler
classes.description: Extends EventScheduler to schedule MIDI events, managing a pool of MidiEvent instances and providing a MidiReceiver for processing incoming MIDI messages.

classes.name: MidiEvent
classes.description: Represents a scheduled MIDI event, extending SchedulableEvent, encapsulating MIDI message data and timestamp.

methods.name: createScheduledEvent
methods.description: Creates a new MidiEvent object with provided MIDI message data and scheduling timestamp, reusing pooled events when possible.

methods.name: addEventToPool
methods.description: Recycles MidiEvent objects back into the pool for reuse, ensuring memory efficiency.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the MidiReceiver instance used to receive and process MIDI messages.
